title: Timor-Leste formally joins AIPA as 11th member parliament

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — House Speaker Faustino “Bojie” G. Dy III welcomed the National Parliament of Timor-Leste on Wednesday as the 11th member of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Inter-Parliamentary Assembly (Aipa), of which he is the president. The announcement of Timor-Leste’s admission took place during the 47th Aipa General Assembly in Manila, marking a historic expansion of the regional parliamentary organization. It was met with applause from Southeast Asian parliamentary leaders, delegates, and observers a year after the country formally joined Asean.
